name: agents-comm-bus-claude
description: Universal agent communication bus for Claude Code. One plugin per supported comm (Telegram first; Matrix, Discord, Slack to follow). Each plugin bootstraps the per-user agents-comm-bus daemon and registers its comm adapter.

plugins.name: agents-comm-bus-telegram
plugins.description: Telegram messaging for Claude Code through the agents-comm-bus daemon. Send messages and attachments, receive inbound, route permission prompts and AskUserQuestion choices to inline keyboards.
